stories.title: Federal officers kill a man in Minneapolis, and DHS offers few details
stories.summary: Federal immigration officers shot and killed a U.S. citizen on Saturday in Minneapolis, drawing hundreds of protesters in a city already shaken by another fatal shooting earlier this month. DHS says the man was armed and "violently resisted" arrest but refused to answer further questions.

stories.title: Reporters describe covering a massive immigration sweep on the ground in Minneapolis
stories.summary: For two weeks, Minneapolis has seen protests and clashes between demonstrators and federal immigration agents, as the administration continues its aggressive campaign to arrest undocumented immigrants.

stories.title: Greenland, tariffs and NATO: a rollercoaster week in transatlantic relations
stories.summary: After President Trump's upheaval at Davos, U.S. allies are openly questioning whether Washington can still anchor the rules-based order.

stories.title: Is Greenland really a land of untapped riches? A geologist went looking in the 1990s
stories.summary: Is Greenland a land of rare earth riches? The Indicator tells the story of an Australian geologist who learned the great cost of extracting Greenland's minerals.

stories.title: Two feet of snow possible in the Northeast as the storm pushes east and temperatures plunge
stories.summary: A dangerous winter storm is cutting across the nation's midsection, from New Mexico all the way up through Maine. More than 100,000 customers lost their power, and thousands of weekend flights were cancelled.

stories.title: Why a century-old tile game is suddenly drawing younger players
stories.summary: A surge of interest in mahjong is building new, in-person community in Washington D.C. as players look for joy, connection, and time off their phones.
